castlenavigation-desc: Audit view for the Castle's room navigation: every room's exits, and which destinations are broken.

nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry-desc: Pages in this category contain a <navigation/> tag but have no entry in the navigation map, so they tell the reader there is nowhere to go.
